title: Line sketch: Spheres of Retro Futurism
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A transparent bubble chair with white cushions anchors the mid-century patio scene, flanked by a multi-sphere floor lamp and scattered orbs. Partial view of an vintage car appears on the left against sleek modern architecture. Clean lines, flat color blocks, and soft gradients define the digital illustration technique (derived from painting #158).
